legacy_projection.route_title: Grid Search Optimization of Air|SiO2|TiO2|Glass Two-Layer AR Coating
legacy_projection.compilation_rationale: The request specifies a fixed two-layer stack (SiO2, TiO2) with explicit thickness bounds [40, 160] nm. The objective is minimizing mean reflectance in the 450-700 nm band for s-polarization at normal incidence. This maps directly to an optimization task using the smatrix solver. No clarification is needed as all parameters are defined.
